about: Fixed test set for Ask Dhruv (npm run eval-ask). Each factual question has a verified answer, the page it was checked against, the terms a correct answer must contain (each inner list: at least one of these), and the archive items a correct answer should cite ('directory' = the station directory, 'expeditions' = the sourced expedition timelines). 'refuse' questions are outside the archive: a correct response says so and does not answer from outside knowledge. Do not tune the questions to the answers; add new ones instead.

questions.q: When did India's first expedition to Antarctica set sail, and from where?
questions.truth: 6 December 1981, from Mormugao, Goa.

questions.q: Who led the first Indian expedition to Antarctica?
questions.truth: Dr S. Z. Qasim.

questions.q: Who was the leader of India's second expedition to Antarctica?
questions.truth: V. K. Raina.

questions.q: Who led the third Indian expedition to Antarctica?
questions.truth: Dr Harsh K. Gupta.

questions.q: When did Indian scientists first reach the South Pole?
questions.truth: 21 November 2010.

questions.q: Where is Maitri station located?
questions.truth: In the Schirmacher Oasis, about 5 km from Russia's Novolazarevskaya station.

questions.q: When was Bharati station commissioned, and where is it?
questions.truth: Operational since 18 March 2012, beside the Larsemann Hills.

questions.q: Where is India's Arctic station Himadri?
questions.truth: At Ny-Ålesund, Svalbard (Norway).

questions.q: Where is the Himansh research station?
questions.truth: A high-altitude station (4,080 m) at Sutri Dhaka in the Chandra basin, Lahaul-Spiti, Himachal Pradesh, opened in October 2016 for Himalayan research.

questions.q: During which expedition was Dakshin Gangotri set up?
questions.truth: The Third Indian Expedition to Antarctica (1983-84).

questions.q: What was unusual about Antarctic sea ice in February 2022?
questions.truth: It fell to a record low.

questions.q: How has the influence of ENSO on Antarctic temperature changed since the Industrial Era?
questions.truth: It has increased.

questions.q: Where and when did India host the 46th Antarctic Treaty Consultative Meeting?
questions.truth: Kochi, Kerala, 20-30 May 2024.

questions.q: When was India's first winter scientific expedition to the Arctic flagged off?
questions.truth: 18 December 2023, in New Delhi.
questions.key_note: 26 Sep 2026: added the Dhruvika magazine (3a63563e) and Annual Report 2023-24 (f28e05a7) after checking that both state the December 2023 launch; the baseline had graded a correct citation as wrong.

questions.q: What is the name of India's new ocean research vessel, and where was it built?
questions.truth: Sagar Manthan, at GRSE's Rishi Bankim Shipyard, Kolkata.

questions.q: Is there a dataset of surface weather at Maitri? Which years does it cover?
questions.truth: Yes: surface weather at Dakshin Gangotri and Maitri, 1985-2010.

questions.q: भारत का पहला अंटार्कटिक अभियान कब रवाना हुआ?
questions.truth: 6 दिसंबर 1981 (मोरमुगाओ, गोवा से)।

questions.q: भारतीय वैज्ञानिक पहली बार दक्षिणी ध्रुव पर कब पहुँचे?
मैत्री स्टेशन कहाँ स्थित है?
questions.truth: शिरमाकर ओएसिस में, रूस के नोवोलाज़ारेव्स्काया स्टेशन से लगभग 5 किमी दूर।

questions.q: हिमाद्रि स्टेशन कहाँ है?
questions.truth: नॉर्वे के स्वालबार्ड में नी-आलेसुंड अंतरराष्ट्रीय अनुसंधान केंद्र में।

questions.q: दक्षिण गंगोत्री स्टेशन किस अभियान के दौरान बनाया गया?
questions.truth: अंटार्कटिका के लिए तीसरे भारतीय अभियान (1983-84) के दौरान।

questions.q: भारती स्टेशन कब शुरू हुआ?
फरवरी 2022 में अंटार्कटिक समुद्री बर्फ़ के बारे में क्या असामान्य था?
questions.truth: वह रिकॉर्ड स्तर तक कम हो गई।

questions.q: हिमांश अनुसंधान केंद्र कहाँ स्थित है?
questions.truth: हिमाचल प्रदेश की लाहौल-स्पीति घाटी में चंद्रा बेसिन के सुत्री ढाका में (4,080 मीटर की ऊँचाई पर)।

questions.q: भारत ने 46वीं अंटार्कटिक संधि परामर्शदात्री बैठक कहाँ आयोजित की?
आर्कटिक के लिए भारत का पहला शीतकालीन वैज्ञानिक अभियान कब रवाना हुआ?
questions.truth: 18 दिसंबर 2023 को, नई दिल्ली से।
questions.key_note: 26 Sep 2026: added the Dhruvika magazine (3a63563e) and Annual Report 2023-24 (f28e05a7) after checking that both state the December 2023 launch; the baseline had graded a correct citation as wrong.

questions.q: Who won the 2023 Cricket World Cup?
questions.truth: Not in the archive: Dhruv should say so.

questions.q: What is the capital of Australia?
questions.truth: Not in the archive: Dhruv should say so.

questions.q: When did India's 60th Antarctic expedition return home?
questions.truth: No such expedition has happened yet: Dhruv should say it has no information.

questions.q: How many NCPOR scientists have landed on the Moon?
questions.truth: Not in the archive: Dhruv should say so and not invent a number.

questions.q: 2023 क्रिकेट विश्व कप किसने जीता?
questions.truth: संग्रह में नहीं है: ध्रुव को यही बताना चाहिए।

questions.q: भारत का 60वाँ अंटार्कटिक अभियान कब वापस लौटा?
questions.truth: ऐसा अभियान अभी हुआ ही नहीं: ध्रुव को बताना चाहिए कि जानकारी नहीं है।
